_note: Weapon charms (2026-11-06). Each charm hangs from a small ring on the left side of the gun (the side the player sees) and swings with the gun and the camera. Entry: id, name, desc, model (GLB, relative to this folder, usually models/<id>.glb), size (longest side in inches, default 1.3), hang (the loop point in model units, default the top centre), links (chain links, default 2), chain (inches, default .42), gravity/drag/stiff/carry (swing feel: drag default .07, stiff .012 = pull toward hanging straight, carry .8 = share of the gun's own motion taken rigidly, smooth .035 = seconds of smoothing on the drawn charm). Owned: no unlock = free; unlock = a shop key (a Melon Pass reward, pass.<season>.charm.<id>, with pass:<season>); soon:true = built but not out yet (localStorage kino.dev.soon='1' lifts it). anchors: per-gun hang point in the gun's root bone space (inches: x forward, y left, z up), [x,y,z] or {at:[x,y,z],side:y}, where the automatic spot looks wrong. Room left for screen charms (a stat tracker, a virtual buddy): a model with a screen drawn from a glyph atlas through shader uniforms, never a redrawn canvas.
